proposed_change.sample_identity: Use (run_id, run_attempt) for separately preregistered full-workflow invocations, instead of requiring forty distinct run IDs.
proposed_change.baseline_execution: Rerun the original baseline PR workflow; GitHub documents preservation of original GITHUB_SHA and GITHUB_REF. Verify actual workflow, checkout SHA/tree and native artifacts before accepting any sample.
proposed_change.candidate_execution: Publish and review an exact candidate PR source/merge/workflow, establish its initial real-PR run, then use registered full reruns of that fixed event/source. Stop if source equivalence cannot be proven.
proposed_change.timing: Bind a queued attempt before its outcome, retain request/queue timestamps, derive each attempt wait from its own new invocation rather than the original historical run created_at. If an authenticated attempt-specific queued time is unavailable, do not treat this method as feasible or start the comparison window.
proposed_change.failure_and_cost_policy: Each reserved sample retains its failure/cancellation and all its own retry/job costs. A later attempt never replaces an unfavorable reserved sample. Primary run cumulative costs must not be counted repeatedly across samples.
